items.name: Toolbar order is Open File → Open Folder → Print
Folder tree setSelected does not rebuild the tree
Folder tree refresh is opt-in via force
Print opens by blit, not PNG encode
Native File menu and IPC print exist
Header and footer reserve 7 mm each
Custom 50% scale is half of fit
Preset panel min width follows effect labels
Edit tool change recalculates window min width
Edit Print button is wired to preview
Effect progress is shown on the edit status bar
Edit window has in-app save / unsaved popups
Effect apply also opens the progress popup
FormatSupport exposes animated / TIFF / HEIC / DICOM helpers
Sample SVG exists and is readable
App icons exist as svg / png / ico
App icon SVG includes a pencil
Drive buttons live in the folder-view title
Virtual prev/next on the image pane
Main status bar has progress (no modal overlay for load)
ko.json and en.json have the same keys
